disposition_reason: The full source paper contains an original ordered held-out localizer decoding endpoint in Fig. 3C,D. Its exact fold/roster/aggregation and numeric author baseline are not yet recovered, so the task remains source-unresolved rather than excluded solely because the legacy reactivation endpoint is descriptive.

source_paper.title: Heuristics in risky decision-making relate to preferential representation of information

evidence.locator: Results, Figs. 3–5; Methods: Participants, MEG analysis, Decoding outcome stimuli, Relating behavioral weighting of information to preferential representation of stimuli
evidence.supports: The registered result relates within-participant decoded reactivation to between-participant heuristic weights. Seven-fold localizer classification is a separate decoder validation step; the paper does not define held-out participant prediction of behavioral weights as this result.

evidence.locator: Task_Reactivation_Analysis.m; paired classifier script Train_Classifiers_Apply_To_Task.m at revision 1c9b3c92c77d4f5a4e4ccfa36d5a695814a2f612
evidence.supports: Author analysis computes reactivation maps and group associations from localizer-trained classifiers; source code was inspected statically.

The existing implementation explicitly describes prospective participant-held-out prediction, unresolved author parity, and no authentic full-cohort qualification. Its LOPO MSE is not a paper baseline.

evidence.locator: Fig. 3C,D and Methods: Decoding outcome stimuli
evidence.supports: The paper itself evaluates held-out localizer outcome-stimulus decoding with seven-fold cross-validation. Three classifiers are tested at train/test timepoint combinations; an example is correct when its target classifier has the highest activation. This is an original ordered accuracy endpoint, distinct from the descriptive reactivation/heuristic association.

target.description: Original Fig. 3C,D localizer decoding of outcome-stimulus identity is an ordered candidate for the whole-paper objective. Its exact scored timepoint map/aggregation and full original evaluation must be selected and bound; the existing neural–behavior association is calibration only.

dataset.description: Source MEG risky-choice/localizer recordings are linked in the registration to OpenNeuro ds005065/1.0.0. The complete mapping from that version to all source event tables and behavior-fit artifacts was not independently resolved.

cohort.description: The paper includes 19 main-analysis participants after two exclusions from 21 recruits. The exact Fig. 3 decoder participant/trial roster and eligibility must be recovered and bound without narrowing it to convenient files.

split.description: Original Fig. 3 uses seven-fold localizer cross-validation (6/7 training, 1/7 testing) across train/test timepoints. Recover original fold assignments, class/null handling and penalty-selection relationship before admission; nested participant-held-out prediction is a different task.

inputs.description: Candidate requires original localizer sensor epochs and stimulus labels for outcome-vs-other-plus-null classifiers, with all original eligible trials/participants. Exact released event/epoch correspondence for the Fig. 3 evaluation remains unbound.

preprocessing.description: Paper describes 0.5-Hz high-pass, 100-Hz downsampling, OSL sensor/ICA cleaning, absolute-95th-percentile scaling and lasso logistic classifiers. Exact source scaling helper, fold-bound preprocessing and historical penalty selection for the Fig. 3 baseline remain to be reconciled.

metric.description: Held-out localizer classification accuracy is ordered higher-is-better; source Fig. 3C,D uses the highest of three outcome-classifier activations as the prediction. Exact map cells and primary aggregation/numeric baseline have not been frozen.

aggregation.description: Recover Fig. 3C,D averaging across folds, outcome classes, timepoints and participants. Do not select a favorable diagonal or latency after evaluation or substitute LOPO behavioral-parameter MSE.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Fig. 3 localizer held-out classification accuracy; exact primary map/aggregation unresolved.

published_baseline.description: No scalar baseline is admitted: recover the paper’s Fig. 3C,D score or a source-authorized rerun under its seven-fold localizer protocol and exact aggregation. The descriptive association and prospective LOPO MSE are not substitutes.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No reproduced author score for the original decoding candidate is established. The existing descriptive/reference-reconstruction implementation remains calibration only and cannot supply this baseline.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful effect cannot be justified until one original decoding endpoint, its metric scale, source baseline and original sampling design are bound. No generic margin is assigned.

uncertainty.method: Recover the original evaluation units and dependence structure, then predeclare paired uncertainty for the bound original decoder comparison; no confidence threshold is invented.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant with localizer trials nested; seven folds and temporal map cells are correlated.
uncertainty.rationale: Repeated folds, random subsamples, overlapping windows or decoder repetitions are not independent biological replicates. Exact original protocol and eligible units must be recovered before admission.

paper_win_requires: Bind the original Fig. 3C,D localizer decoding target, all eligible source participants/trials, class/null definition and seven-fold protocol.
Recover the reported accuracy with exact timepoint aggregation and author baseline route; preserve the source penalty-selection procedure and any evaluation reuse transparently.
Freeze candidate and meaningful effect/uncertainty/access/resource rules before final evaluation. A new participant split or behavioral-parameter target is an extension, never the original paper win.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison is claimed; any later SOTA assessment requires its own primary-source verification.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending recovery and binding of an ordered decoding endpoint actually evaluated in this source paper. Once admitted, iterate only with the original permitted training/validation access.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze the selected original endpoint, full cohort, source split, preprocessing, baseline route, candidate method and resource/access budgets before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare on the same original source-paper task and evaluation protocol only after baseline recovery; no local descriptive reconstruction score or newly invented split can earn a paper win.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep paper-reported scores, a source-authorized author rerun, local descriptive calibration and any later SOTA comparator distinct. No original score is inferred from local numerical agreement. Where the source protocol itself uses stochastic draws, a faithful rerun may use declared provenance, a justified reproduction tolerance and paired candidate-author draws; fixed source partitions and full original condition support must remain unchanged.

blocking_issues: Original Fig. 3 accuracy baseline and primary timepoint/class/participant aggregation are not recovered.
Exact original folds, event/epoch identities, author scaling helper and penalty-selection provenance remain unresolved.
Current evaluator’s nested LOPO behavioral-weight MSE changes both target and split; it cannot evaluate this original decoding candidate.

legacy.notes: The initial evaluator reconstructs localizer decoding and first-level effects, then adds nested leave-one-participant-out ridge prediction and MSE. This new generalization task has no source-paper performance comparator and must remain a separately labelled extension; stronger association or reduced local implementation error cannot be a paper win.
